description: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain percentage for different models under strong and weak supervision. The horizontal axis contains the model categories, labeled as "Claude-3.5-Sonnet" and "Qwen2-72B", although the first category label is truncated. The vertical axis is labeled "Performance Gain (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 25, and tick labels at intervals of 5. Each model category is represented by a pair of bars, with the striped bar representing "Strong Supervision" and the solid bar representing "Weak Supervision". The "Strong Supervision" bars are consistently taller than the "Weak Supervision" bars across both models, with values of approximately 25 and 7 for the first model, 14 and 8 for "Claude-3.5-Sonnet", and 23 and 16 for "Qwen2-72B". The bars are grouped by model category, with no specific sorting order observed. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bar.
